items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass
items.rationale: Both materials are debris from insured storm damage under 2.5.3(c) and 5.2.1(a), so the combined line passes 7.1.10. Using Case 8 as calibration, allow €65 for timber plus €32 for glass, gross, before any event deductible not stated in the supplied policy.

items.description: Mixed green waste, oversized root mass and soil
items.rationale: Section 5.2.1(d)–(e) excludes the soil and the single root mass exceeding 1 m³, and no qualifying reinstatement ground works under 5.2.2 are described. Section 7.1.10 therefore bars the whole line, including the otherwise eligible green waste; €250 is a conditional gross estimate for the whole load, not an allowance.

Paving grit is ground material excluded by 5.2.1(d), and its stand-alone disposal does not meet the reinstatement and making-good requirements of 5.2.2. The €30 figure is a conditional gross disposal estimate only.

Sieving does not change topsoil's exclusion as ground material under 5.2.1(d), and no qualifying reinstatement and making good under 5.2.2 is described. The €35 figure is a conditional gross disposal estimate only.
